# Fogo

> Customizable Chrome productivity extension and modular new tab dashboard.

## Core Features
- Drag-and-drop workspace: arrange widgets at any coordinate.
- Developer integrations: GitHub activity, Asana tasks, Google Calendar.
- Market tracking: Live trading charts, cryptocurrency and stock watchlists.
- 22 dynamic aesthetic themes (Minimal, Glassmorphism, Dark Synth, Focus).
- Tab Stash: Instantly hibernates background tabs to reclaim up to 2.8 GB RAM.
- Local-first privacy: 100% offline-ready, zero telemetry, no tracking servers.
